text:
anya: Heads-up: DAST jobs in prod started failing after last night's keystore rotation. Failures show 401/unauthorized when fetching runtime auth token for scanner. Blocking a few customer-facing deploys.

devops: noticed alert too. logs: https://logs.internal/tx/61555zzz -> error: token validation failed: key version mismatch. KMS shows rotation happened at 2026-03-22T02:00Z.

build-bot: automated: 7 DAST runs failed, created ticket DAST-ROTATION-6155.

sam: quick theory: rotation created new key version but scanner SA still has cached token signed by previous key. We need graceful key rollover or short token TTL.

anya: agree. immediate mitigation: backfill ephemeral token issuance from infra and restart scanner pods. can someone do a hotfix?

devops: restarting scanner pod now. also checking if token cache TTL can be reduced.

sam: longer-term: two ideas: 1) implement key-handle aliasing so services always reference cryptoKeyName without baking keyVersion, 2) add a pre-rotation smoke check that runs a synthetic DAST auth flow 30m before rotation and aborts rotation if it fails.

sec-oncall: add to playbook: when keystore rotation occurs, run "dast-auth-smoke" and wait for green before committing rotation. also log rotation_id in audit entries and include in alert.

anya: suggested smoke check command (k8s exec example):

```
kubectl exec -n scanners scanner-0 -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://scanner.internal/healthz?auth_test=${ROTATION_ID}"
```

devops: terraform snippet to pin alias usage in KMS resource:

```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key" "dast_key" {
  name     = "projects/${var.project}/locations/global/keyRings/dast/cryptoKeys/dast-key"
  rotation_period = "86400s"
}

resource "google_kms_crypto_key_version" "dast_key_version" {
  crypto_key = google_kms_crypto_key.dast_key.id
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = false
  }
}
```

anya: also proposing "evidence escrow": if DAST cannot attach encrypted artifact due to KMS errors, pipeline should upload unencrypted evidence to an internal escrow bucket with short retention and generate an audit record so triage can still proceed. mark findings as provisional.

sam: escrow is OK short-term but must be gated: require SRE+sec approval to enable, narrow ACLs, and auto-delete within 48h. add alert if escrow writes occur.

devops: implemented a temp restart, DAST pods passed health check. will open infra RFC for aliasing and pre-rotation smoke checks.

sec-oncall: action items: - devops: add pre-rotation smoke to rotation runbook (ETA 48h) - sam: draft escrow gating controls and retention policy (ETA EOD) - anya: add rotation_id to DAST logs + hook into alerts (PR tomorrow) - sec-oncall: add rotation smoke to incident playbook and escalation rules

anya: quick Q: does anyone own the rotation change approvals in the org? need to add a stake-holder sign-off in the runbook.

sam: infra owner is @infra-eng, will loop them into the RFC.

devops: filing the RFC now and attaching logs + a small PoC smoke script. link when done.

(emoji reactions: :warning: from sec-oncall, :rocket: from devops)
